name: Panama Disease (Fusarium Wilt of Banana)
description: A soil-borne vascular wilt disease that is highly destructive to bananas. The fungus persists in soil for decades and is considered one of the most damaging banana diseases globally, with Tropical Race 4 posing the greatest threat.
symptoms: Yellowing of older leaves progressing inward
Leaf petioles collapsing and hanging around pseudostem
Vascular discoloration visible as reddish-brown streaks
No fruit production or deformed bunches
causes: Infected soil, water, or plant material movement
treatments: Remove and destroy infected plants including roots
prevention: Disinfect tools and equipment between fields
Avoid moving soil from infected areas
